evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says: 'This would take within the next five to ten minutes of your time would that be okay?' — frames time but skips the dependable quote promise and moves to probing without waiting for full confirmation.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'What are your biggest concerns or are there any important things that you wanted to answer during this call?' but this comes AFTER asking about the first location address and story details, violating the Section 2 precedence rule.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer says 'No, just looking to get a quote' — no concerns raised, so N/A per rubric.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns were raised by customer, so no reflection needed — N/A per rubric.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covers property type (1-story, then 2-story), bedrooms (3 each), additional rooms (shed with bikes/camping/tools), parking (driveway at both), access concerns (none), special items (TV, bookcase, small gun safe, couch, two beds to dismantle/rebuild, mirror), and additional stops (storage unit at 12915 Research Boulevard with refrigerator).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asks: 'Do you need help in packing or net at all?' and confirms 'Full house' packing needed.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asks: 'A typical back count or number of boxes based on your home size is 45 to 55 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives typical range for 1200 sq ft home (2 movers, 6-8 hours per day, two-day move) and personalizes it to customer's prep level: 'The most important one is how well prepared you are when we get there... if you still have extra time just to prepare... the small items into your boxes yourself that would really help.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep covers hourly rate ($110/hr per mover), what's included (truck, gas, taxes, insurance, wraps, pads, tools), packing materials cost ($300 materials only), no hidden fees, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increment proration. Full fee transparency.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or similar check-in with silence — moves directly from pricing explanation into move date discussion.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep states: 'We have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep states: 'First is that we have no worry, damage coverage included on the R. Weight that you're paying us. We will provide up to 2000 dollars per move that is to repair replace and reimburse for your items.' — covers the $2,000 and that it's built in, but does not explicitly state 'no deductible / no fine print.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put these to rest?' or similar confirmation after delivering the two promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any version of final concerns check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep says: 'And that he truly believe that were the best move-in town would you like our help with your move.' — this IS an explicit ask, but it is immediately followed by customer response 'I would love for you email me the quote information...' Without an out being offered by the rep, customer creates their own exit. Rep does NOT soften it with an out, so this is 'full' on the ask itself, but rep fails to handle the objection cleanly.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep says: 'There's no deposit required, no res, securing your spot. If something comes up and the things change at your end then you can always reschedule or cancel with a quick call, no fees for that either.' — confirms no deposit to secure.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirms move dates (Oct 13 packing, Oct 14 moving, both available, 8:30-9:00 AM start) and no deposit required, but does NOT confirm phone number, exact arrival window in detail, crew size stated for this booking, or notes left for crew about customer's concerns. Partial only.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details across both locations, handled special items (gun safe, beds to dismantle, bookcase, additional stop) methodically, and delivered full pricing transparency with clear fee and rate structure.
coaching_note: Section 2's 'Their Agenda' must be asked BEFORE any probing starts (rep asked it after address details were already gathered), and Section 6's final concerns check and Section 4's 'Does that feel fair?' are completely missing — these are load-bearing closes that prevent objections from slipping through silently.
